column5: The ios_base::Init startup routine at 0xcc18 / 0xcdc0 passes this address as its object. initWithFrame: stores self at offset 4; dealloc clears the same word.
Binds GL_RENDERBUFFER with the engine's renderbuffer ID, receives width and height and recomputes the viewport and projection.
This closure sends copy to its first argument and stores the result into the captured view's leaderboard ivar.
First view block that centers the captured view's banner at the top. Its adjacent copy/dispose helpers are referenced by the descriptor at 0xe07d0.
The renderer initialization routine logs Engine :: OpenGL Config., allocates two render targets, and sets the blend function. See src/renderer.c.
Both bodies independently match engine_set_touches in src/native.c. Each copies the touch coordinate arrays into engine storage.
The per-frame driver in src/engine_frame.c advances timers and objects, calls the game's update and draw methods, and submits the frame.
The ConfigureTitle animation captures the view and centers the banner at y = 0. Its verified copy and dispose helpers immediately follow the callback.
The Game Center callback presents its supplied controller or sends checkLocalPlayer to the captured view. Its two verified helpers are named by the block descriptor at 0xe0830.
The RoundEnded animation captures the view and centers the banner at y = 0. Its separate copy and dispose helpers are named by the descriptor at 0xe0850.
The native game constructor independently matches src/gameplay_init.c on both slices. It initializes the base engine, installs the game method table and assigns the saved score and play count.
The score submission callback is independently identified by the global block literal at 0xe0878. It logs success when Game Center passes a nil error.
